"Back to you" Once Jeonghu begins to investigate his father's case, the team ordered by the Elder begins to take action. Munsik plants seeds of suspicion into Yeongsin, and Munho decides to tell her the truth before Munsik could do it. Yeongsin is in shock when she hears the secret Munho and Jeonghu had been keeping from her. Jeonghu chases the truth about his father in order to go back to Yeongsin, but...

"Will you answer me?" Without having a chance to clear up Yeongsin's misunderstanding, Jeonghu continues investigating what happened to his father. Boss' special team is on Jeonghu's tail to cover up the truth he uncovers. Yeongsin visits Myeonghui to find her truth as well, and ends up seeing Jeonghu there. Those under Munho come together and their operation begins...

"Like ordinary people" The truth of what happened that fateful day is finally exposed, thanks to the tape of Junseok's testimony. Jeonghu decides to stay by Yeongsin's side, and live like ordinary people. The first step of living an average life is meeting his girlfriend's father. However, Munho continues his attack on Boss, who was also exposed along with the truth about Junseok, and Someday falls under attack.

"I'll protect you" Boss uses the same tactic he used on Munsik to own Jeonghu, but Jeonghu bets on himself and leaves Yeongsin to face off against him. Munho and Someday News do not give in to his threats and continue to report on Boss' identity. However, Minja, who has been helping Jeonghu, ends up being tracked by Munsik's cyber team...

"Goodbye, Healer" Boss uses Yeongsin's and Munho's weaknesses to continue threatening them, and Jeonghu feels his limitations in fighting him alone. Minja gathers everyone together, and Munho and Yeongsin prepare a retaliation interview. The day before the big day, Jeonghu prepares a gift for Yeongsin and makes a final decision for the welfare of everyone else.

For now, they attend to a couple of patients from a construction site accident.

Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

King Seonjo orders Gwanghae, Imhae, and Shinseong to find a way to end the people's widespread stomach illness, prompting Gwanghae to disguise himself and investigate in secret. While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

Despite Taedo's warnings that it is dangerous, Jeongi insists she must remain at the Bunwon to bring Gangcheon down from his nangcheong post. Reunited with Jeongi at the workshop, Gwanghae cannot hide his quiet delight. Meanwhile, Yukdo grows uneasy when he is forced to compete with Jeongi to create the lid for King Seonjo's cherished jar. He promises Jeongi that if she succeeds, he will elevate her to the rank of master potter.

When King Seonjo selects Yukdo's lid, Yukdo struggles to contain his joy, while Jeongi graciously acknowledges his skill. Gwanghae petitions the king to lift the Chief Scholar's exile, but Seonjo misinterprets the request as a threat to royal authority. Seizing the moment, Inbin plots to frame Gwanghae for treason by forging his letter. As Jeongi departs on Gangcheon's errand to mine white clay, Gwanghae mounts his horse and races after her.

Upon returning to the palace, Gwanghae insists that the letter King Seonjo presents to him has been forged—but the king refuses to believe it. Jeongi is shaken when Imhae warns her that anyone tied to the alleged treason will not escape unscathed. When Jeongi meets Gwanghae, she vows to restrain even her own feelings so as not to become a burden to him. Court Lady Gukbi is stunned to learn that Jeongi is Yeonok's daughter.

After uncovering the full truth, Jeongi begins searching for a way to bring about Gangcheon's downfall, with Taedo pledging to help her. When Jeongi and Gwanghae cross paths at the Bunwon, they share a tender, wordless gaze filled with longing. Upon discovering a ledger detailing Gangcheon's bribes, Jeongi resolves to win Royal Consort Inbin's favor. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong decides to eliminate Son Haengsu.

A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. When the Shane Gang travel to the Auroris Mine, they discover a legendary monster carved out of stone attacking the mines-the Pyritor. Trixie studies the legend to help them locate the creature's home and put a stop to its reign of terror, but first they must confront the true nature of the beast, and its assistant!

Determined to up his game against Stone Warriors, Kord visits a famous Eastern Technician for help creating a new blaster upgrade. Building the new upgrade is difficult...but working with the Technician is practically impossible!

A winter-time holiday has arisen in the Eastern Caverns around the mysterious "Giver," who makes an annual visit to deliver slugs to the people of the East. But when a group of thieves make off with the Giver's precious cargo of slugs, our heroes must ride to the rescue-and discover the secret of who the Giver really is.

programmes.st: The Fall of the Eastern Champion
programmes.d: Junjie recounts the ancient history of the Eastern Caverns and his ancestors, and the events that led to his downfall and transformation from the Eastern Champion to the Dark Slinger.
When Pronto accidentally uses the Emperor's sword blaster, he can suddenly do no wrong. Lady Dai-Fu manipulates Underlord Holt into trapping the Shane Gang with a new superweapon: the Iron Warrior!

The Emperor has returned! After the Shane Gang failed to defeat the Iron Warrior, the Emperor sets to work creating even more Unstoppable Warriors to reclaim the Eastern Caverns. The Shane Gang search for a way to defeat the new creations, but when the Emperor places a bounty on Junjie's head, they also have to deal with the Dai-Fu and hordes of the Emperor's Underlords.

programmes.st: The Return of the Eastern Champion
programmes.d: Junjie, Eli and the Gang rally their friends and even some old enemies-to help them take down the Emperor.

The Shane Gang return home to the 99 caverns to find Gateway Cavern overrun with slugs-in Eli's absence, the Shadow Clan have governed by putting the slugs before the people, and the result is chaos! It's up to Eli to restore the balance, but the Shadow Clan aren't as friendly as they once were...and that's saying something. Help comes from an unexpected source-Tad and his slug Pieper, who just arrived from the Surface!

The Shane Gang take Tad under their wing, training him to blast like a pro with Eli's old blaster and teaching him to live by the slugslinger's code. Tad takes to it like a natural, and as Kord says, it looks like they have another "slugslinging savant from the Surface" on their hands. But their training will be put to the test when Tad accompanies them to a showdown with the Scrap Force...and the Shadow Clan!

Tad is still missing after the slug-out with the Shadow Clan, but the Gang have to set off without him when reports start coming in of slugs disappearing all across the 99 caverns. As they pursue the trail of missing slugs, the mystery grows darker when it leads them straight to Dr. Blakk's old stronghold!

Tad's hypnotic slug Pieper has gone megamorph, his gang of supporters all have Gattler blasters, and Tad's control over his army of ghouls is stronger than Dr. Blakk's ever was. The Shane Gang are under non-stop ghoul fire as they struggle to put a stop to Tad's plans and end the mass ghouling of slugs once and for all.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 1
programmes.d: 15-year-old Eli Shane is a regular kid except for one thing: he comes from a long line of Shanes, each who has journied from the surface to protect Slugterra and the slugs that make the world special.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 2
programmes.d: Now its Eli's turn to be Slugterra's next Shane, whether he's ready or not! Unfortunately, the slugslinging tournament he enters to prove that he's ready, pretty quickly shows that he's not!

After the Shane hideout is ransacked, the gang trades in one of Eli's prized slugs for new gear. When Eli has second thoughts they go back to get it, only to learn that it's been sold to Dr. Blakk, along with hundreds of others to be transformed into feral Ghoul Slugs. Eli refuses to let his slug or any other get ghouled, so the team breaks in to Blakk's fortress to free them. While inside, they learn of Blakk's plan to conquer Slugterra.

A group of Freedom Fighters is obliterated by a swarm of metallic fly-bots. When Manic goes looking for the insects, he is stung with serum.
A speed enhancing fluid deemed Sonic Tonic is created by Robotnik to make him as fast as Sonic so that he may finally catch him.
The Hedgehogs congregate on the Floating Island in their latest effort to find their mother. But Sleet and Dingo also have an interest in this island.
As Sonic begins to chow chili dogs for a snack, he finds a message in the sack from his mother urging him to head to Speedster Island.
Big Griz, leader of a group of biker-bear rebels, mistakes Scratch and Grounder for Sonic and Tails, and teams up with S and G to attack the real Sonic and Tails.
Tails gets a megadose of Robotniks growth gas and grows quickly to monstrous proportions, eating everything in sight and accidentally terrorizing the countryside.

When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home, Robotnik finds out, and creates a robot fox family which poses as Tails' long lost parents. Sonic leaves Tails with the fox family, but finally realizes they're robots and rescues Tails.

An elderly, out of shape, overweight superhero keeps trying to help Sonic battle Dr. Robotnik, and keeps getting him in more jepordy. Sonic helps the old hero regain his self respect and they team up to battle Robotnik's latest scheme.

After an accident, Scratch thinks he's an eagle and on the side of Sonic. In order to impress his his new lady love, Scratch assists Sonic in an excursion into Robotnik's Fortress to turn off a dangerous force field.
Sonic turns detective to solve the mystery of his missing Red Sneakers--and just in time to get them back and stop Dr. Robotnik's latest attack on a peaceful Mobius village.
Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him.
Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strenghs.
Mobius is suffering a crime spree and all the evidence points to Sonic as the culprit. But the real thief is a lab rat wearing a high-tech vehicle suit who was sent by Robotnik to discredit our hero.

Nick runs into an old college friend, who convinces him to bring Deion Sanders aboard his energy drink business – with humiliating consequences.
Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, but the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.
Former child star Todd Bridges guides Lindsey on a wild odyssey to teach her the dangers of drug use. Ice Cube, Charlie Murphy and Jerry Springer also guest star.
Suzanne insists that everyone in the family tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.
Suzanne's book group and Nick's boxing-match party collide in the family room on the same night, resulting in knock-out clashing.
Suzanne suspects that Nick may have fathered his ex-flame's son. Ice Cube and Kandi Burruss guest star.

Suzanne and Marilyn convene for a spa weekend for Mother's Day, but friction soon mounts between the two.
Lindsey decides to take on a vegan diet and lifestyle, but she may have ulterior motives in doing so.

Kevin and Nick goes to an R-rated movie, but Kevin has nightmares from seeing it.

The crew celebrates the grand re-opening of Black Ink. Ted is on the defense as Melody makes a power play to become manager. O'S**t reveals shocking information about Nikki. Melody catches Ceaser in a compromising position.

Ceaser and the crew turn it up at DMX's birthday party. Sky is determined to stop Kitty from becoming Ceaser's new woman. Someone from Nikki's past shows up with shocking news. And a fancy dinner ends when Sky trashes the table.

An angry Miss Kitty confronts Ceaser about sleeping with Allison. Richard rushes to the hospital after an urgent text message from Nikki. Dutchess gets her groove back with an NFL player after hearing about Ceaser's sex life.

Sky returns to 113th and shares some big news. Ceaser attempts damage control with Miss Kitty. Sky heads to the boardroom to pitch her new workout. All hell breaks loose when Donna says Sky doesn't deserve her promotion.

Ceaser learns a shocking revelation about his relationship with Dutchess. After the loss of their baby, Richard's wife Nikki hits her breaking point. Kitty attempts to make peace with Dutchess. Bae is caught up in a new romance.

Miss Kitty refuses to back down from Dutchess. Ceaser continues to cozy up to Karlie Redd. Richard must decide whether to save his marriage. Ceaser throws a huge bash to celebrate the newest shop in his franchise.

The 113th shop is in shambles when a single Ceaser becomes more interested in chasing women. Donna receives a threatening phone call. Black Ink Atlanta's anniversary party turns into chaos. Dutchess delivers an explosive low blow to Sky.

programmes.st: This Makes My Boricua Come Out, Mami

Ceaser receives alarming news from his doctor and resolves to change his ways. Melody is shocked by Lalo's solution to their financial issues. And Sky heads to Texas to reunite with the children she gave up for adoption 15 years ago.

When $10,000 is stolen from the shop, Ceaser tasks Sky to find the culprit. Bae freaks out when Rob wants to take their relationship to the next level. And Melody has a breakdown when Donna publicly attacks her artistry and questions her character.

Sky loses her cool when Ceaser puts her in charge of 113. Kevin musters the courage to come out to his homophobic father. After an STD scare, Ceaser is forced to break up with his side chicks. Donna's ex-roommate trashes her on the news.
Donna seeks revenge on her ex-roommate. Bae is worried for her mom's safety after she receives death threats from her father. Alex's freedom hangs in the balance.

When Erin is assigned to investigate a case in which an on-duty police officer is accused of killing a suspect already in custody, Frank urges her to stick to the facts to avoid a publicity scandal for the NYPD.
When a detective from Danny’s precinct is killed while working undercover, Frank puts on a full-court press to find his killer, only to discover that the deceased had a big secret.
When Danny is placed on modified duty after investigating a case that was off-limits, he realizes he stumbled upon something that someone is trying to keep quiet.
As Danny and Baez escort confiscated drugs to a remote location for incineration, their convoy is attacked and Baez is seriously injured, leaving Danny to track down the drug cartel responsible.
Danny and Baez are temporarily assigned new partners when an officer is outed and his current partner won't ride with him.

Boomer Esiason will appear as himself when he pays a visit to Commissioner Frank Reagan (Tom Selleck) at his office. Reagan thanks Esiason for his work with the Women and Kids Fundraiser and asks if there is anything he can do for him in return.
When Danny is charged with using excessive force, Frank must decide whether to stand up for his son or for the reputation of his police force.
Jamie is targeted by a vengeful thug after he intervenes in his abusive relationship with his girlfriend.

Frank and Danny are determined to put away an international felon who repeatedly manages to walk away from murder charges, but they struggle to come up with the necessary evidence to earn a conviction.

Frank is blindsided during an on-air interview when he and the interim District Attorney disagree over an issue. Meanwhile, Danny's new boss rides along with him, but their methods and personalities clash as they investigate a drive-by shooting.

Frank faces public backlash after an officer's body camera malfunctions during an altercation with a civilian. Meanwhile, Danny and Baez struggle to protect an informant after the U.S. Marshall's Service decides not to put him in Witness Protection.

As Danny and Baez investigate the murders of three prominent community leaders who appear to be the casualties of hate crimes, Frank meets with a group that wants to make sure these incidents are not taken lightly.
Danny is conflicted when he learns that a group of highly trained Army veterans are responsible for a robbery.

Frank pushes to find evidence against a suspected cop killer who shot one of Henry's fellow officers years ago. Meanwhile, Danny and Baez investigate a string of murders involving adult film stars, on BLUE BLOODS.

Jamie gets Danny involved when he finds a homeless teen who claims his aunt was killed by her boyfriend. Meanwhile, Erin is angered when McCoy replaces her as the prosecutor on a case involving a corrections officer.

Danny and Baez investigate when a homeowner shoots an intruder, only to find out that the intruder is a hitman. Also, a young attorney attempts to bring justice to his mother who Erin put away on a murder charge 12 years ago.
Danny and Baez investigate a murder of a lower-income resident in a luxury building where 20 percent of the units are made affordable for lower-income housing.
Adam, Hoss and Joe mistakenly believe their father was murdered.  They split into 3 different directions to confront the supposed killers.
Joe and Adam protect a saloon girl, who has killed in self-defense, from an angry lynch mob.
Ben's plans to marry Katherine Saunders are upset when her son Eden is accused of killing his former girlfriend.
The Generation Gap, Western-style, as Hoss tries to bring a young man and his father closer together.
Hoss is engaged to Carol Attley, a troubled woman with a past darker than he imagines.
Ben must travel to pay his respects after he learns of the death of his nephew Will. When he visits the grave, he finds his nephew barely alive with a bullet wound.

Determined to prove he can succeed at something without the help of his Pa, Hoss, and Adam, Joe sets out on his quest and wins a timber contract for Ponderosa timber, and later discovers that having a family to rely on can definitely be an asset.
Joe is bushwhacked in the desert and awakens to find himself in Martinville, a town that may or may not be populated by ghosts.  An eerie, surrealistic and well-produced episode.
Feeling guilty for unintentionally ending the career of a professional boxer, Hoss vows never to fight again.  But things change when Joe is nearly beaten to death.
Hoss hires Waldo as a ranch hand after keeping Waldo from killing himself.  Hoss soon learns that Waldo is lousy at his job and only causes problems for everyone else due to his clumsiness.

For a change, it is Adam rather than Joe who becomes mixed up in one of Hoss' funny exploits. Together they purchase a thoroughbred horse, and end up competing against their little brother in the big Virginia City race.
The Cartwrights attempt to straighten out the snobbish young son of Ben's cousin.
Will is having second thoughts about staying on at the Ponderosa, and outlaws hit the ranch and take him with them.

Dolly Bantree has a crooked manager ""Blackie"",  who blackmails Dolly to fleece newly rich miner Buford out of his newfound wealth. Hoss suspects something and gets all duded up to pose as a rich mark to test Dolly.
In what is arguably the best comedy of the series, Hoss swears he has seen green elves running around the Ponderosa and a smooth-talking Irishman complicates matters even worse.
Ben and Hoss unwittingly aid a vengeful army colonel who plans to wipe out every Indian he can with a Gatling gun.
Hoss becomes concerned for the welfare of an insecure, belligerent fellow who is as small as Hoss is large.  Interesting blend of comedy and pathos that ends unpredictably.
Boruto makes a desperate decision to prevent Momoshiki from taking over his consciousness again.
Boruto Uzumaki, the son of the village leader, saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on by bullies.
After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.
After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

programmes.st: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
programmes.d: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof.
A mysterious student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!
Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act.
A Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream, and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother's Hyuga Clan.
Under his father and grandfather's guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. No matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form.

programmes.st: The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
programmes.d: Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow "The Ghost" and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent "Ghost Incidents."
During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi Izuno and Namida Suzumeno get wrapped up in the Ghost Incident and are hurt.
The Ghost incidents suddenly come to an end and Boruto and his classmates are puzzled, but Mitsuki seems to know something they don't.
Seventh Hokage Naruto and his top advisors are shocked to learn who the perpetrator is from the results of Sai's investigation. Just then, Nue, an enormous otherworldly beast, appears!

programmes.st: The Path That Boruto Can See
programmes.d: The late Danzo Shimura was the founder and leader of the Foundation, an elite branch of the ANBU Black Ops. The recent incidents have been masterminded by someone who had sworn to carry on Danzo's wishes.
The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.
Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho.
The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit.
Boruto and his classmates head to the Village Hidden in the Mist in the Land of Water for a field trip.
Boruto and his classmates are invited to tour the Hidden Mist Academy under Kagura and Chojuro's escort.
Tsurushi Hachiya, Kagura's former classmate at the Academy, finds Boruto and his friends from the Leaf irritating, so he kidnaps Denki.
Kagura unwittingly becomes part of a plot set up by Shizuma Hoshigaki, a man who opposes the new, peaceful shinobi order.
The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen begin an insurrection, the end goal being to turn their village back into the Blood Mist Village!

programmes.st: The Sharingan vs. The Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang!
programmes.d: Sarada is forced into one-on-one combat with a kunoichi, Buntan Kurosuki, who wields the Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang! In the thick fog, Sarada uses her Sharingan, but her enemy is stronger than expected
Boruto urges his friend Kagura to return with him, but Kagura rejects him and begins to attack.
The field trip comes to an end, and Boruto and his friends prepare to return to Hidden Leaf. Chojuro, the Mizukage, sees them off, but Kagura is nowhere to be seen.

The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

When a gangster who passes as Oliver's doppelganger arrives in town with his wife and partner to hide out from the law, a rumor spreads that Oliver is a cheat. Oliver seeks to save his good name, and Lisa tries figure out which Oliver is Oliver!

Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

Maude is shocked and outraged when she receives a series of obscene phone calls, but her biggest shock is yet to come when she discovers who's on the other end.
Everyone gets into the act when Maude recruits her family and friends to sing and dance for a questionable charity telethon on the annual musical.
When a fire breaks out in a restaurant where they are dining, Maude and Vivian escape with only surface bruises, but Walter has to cope with a much deeper psychological scar.
Maude is thunderstruck when the Ethiopian foster child she's supported for 20 years comes to America and turns out to be quite different from what she expected.

Betty goes undercover to help Barnaby, J.R. search for a missing young girl. They soon find out that what they've stumbled onto it is a white slavery racket.

Steve McGarrett and agent Danny Williams are enmeshed with a pair of frightened surfers, one of whom was actually responsible for the death of a girl, and the other who is on the run because he is strongly suspected of it.

While Dr. Sloan impatiently waits for Community General to reopen, Caitlin Sweeney resurfaces as a member of R.O.A.R. (Revolutionary Order for Armed Rebellion).
It's Cindy Garrett and Philip Kobler's wedding day and they're taking "til death do us part" literally, when they plan the murder of Cindy's father to take place right after their nuptials!

Dr. Sloan's day begins with a phone call from a kidnapper who happened to dial the wrong number - his! The kidnapper believes he's called the original victim and demands Dr. Sloan deliver money if he wants to see his son alive.

A homicide investigation turns into a federal case when a "corpse" creates a reign of terror at Community General. Amanda prepares for her autopsy on blood-soaked John Doe when he springs to life, putting a stranglehold on Amanda!
After heading out to a mountain cabin, Jesse goes missing, only to turn up five days later in Utah, claiming to have been abducted by aliens.
Novelist Kay Ludlow is dealing with writer's block while her literary agent Jim Rothman pressures her to turn out 350 pages by the following day to secure his two million dollar share.
Amanda cruises into cyberspace during a spell of boredom and randomly enters the website "Welcome to Joanne's living room" for mindless entertainment.
When Jo attempts to break into the IMC ship she is captured and held hostage.
The Master pretends to have come to settle the dispute between the colonists and IMC.
The Master forces the Doctor to take him to the underground city of the primitives.
The Doctor and the Master confront the guardian of the doomsday weapon.
The Doctor tries to prevent Professor Horner from breaking into an ancient barrow.
Devil's End is sealed off from the outside world by a heat barrier.
The Doctor attempts to help the Brigadier penetrate the heat barrier.
The Doctor is captured by the villagers who are under the Master's control.
UNIT have penetrated the heat barrier and launch an attack on the gargoyle, Bok.
Freedom fighters, trying to change history by traveling back in time to prevent the Daleks from conquering Earth, start a temporal paradox. With Jon Pertwee.
Jo tampers with one of the travelers' time machines and is transported into the future.

programmes.t: Doctor Who: The Evil of the Daleks
programmes.d: Jamie explores Maxtible's house; the Doctor is forced by the Daleks to subject his companion to a series of tests.
The rebel humans are about to change history and the Doctor tries to stop them.

programmes.d: The planet Peladon is hoping to join the Galactic Federation.

programmes.st: The Curse of Peladon: Episode Two
programmes.d: The work of the committee is hampered by sabotage, fear and suspicion.

programmes.st: The Curse of Peladon: Episode Three
programmes.d: The Doctor is sentenced to a fight to the death.

programmes.st: The Curse of Peladon: Episode Four
programmes.d: Hepesh is revealed to be behind the attacks.
The Doctor tries to make peace with reptilian Sea Devils persuaded by the Master to help him dominate man. With Jon Pertwee.
The Doctor discovers that the sea creatures are kin to the Silurians, a race he once helped destroy.
The Master devises equipment to contact the sea creatures and help them regain control of Earth.
The Master and the Sea Devils form an alliance.
The Doctor is brought before the chief Sea Devil and counsels peace.
Under duress, the Doctor helps the Master repair a unit that may revive Sea Devils globally.

The Doctor is sent to a skybase orbiting the planet of Solos in the 30th century, where he must deliver a sealed message pod; on the planet below, something is transforming the human population into hideous mutants.
Ky flees to the planet's poisonous surface, taking Jo with him; the Marshal, holding the Doctor captive, demands that he opens the message pod.
The Doctor gives the box to Ky, revealing the contents to be scrolls written in the language of the Old Ones.
The Doctor and Sondergaard make a discovery in the caves of Solos while Jo falls into the Marshal's trap.
The Doctor and Jo are once again sent into danger by the Time Lords when they are given a vital message capsule to deliver.
The Marshal is on trial, with the Doctor as chief witness; Jo and the Doctor's friends are the Marshal's prisoners.
The Master plans to seize the Crystal of Kronos, gaining power over time itself.
The Master manages to transmit the Lost City's High Priest through time into his laboratory.
The High Priest reveals that the Master has only a portion of the crystal that resides in the temple vaults.
Kronos attacks the Doctor.
The Doctor is transported to an eternity of nothingness, as the Master arrives in Atlantis.
A beagle has a chewing problem; three German shepherds must be kept apart; a bichon frisé dislikes her owner.
A Yorkie attacks his leash, plants and a fellow Yorkie; a bull terrier attacks larger dogs; a Jack Russell terrier/Italian greyhound mix barks constantly while her owner is at work.
Cesar Milan's Dog Psychology Center in Los Angeles is both the home and refuge to nearly 50 dogs who are a resource in his work.
Cesar's toughest cases have included a bulldog that munched on skateboards, a dog that gnawed garden hoses and basketballs, and a pit bull with issues.
A Pointer mix is fixated on pine cones, while an Australian shepherd whines every time his owner switches on the vacuum cleaner.
Young fans Jessica and Rachel join Cesar as he deals with a tiny dog with an outsized personality and a nervous pit bull mix afraid of the sea.
Cesar helps owners of rescue dogs including a terrier mix that screams and a Belgian Tervuren scared of her own home; Cesar helps a family adopting their first dog.
Cesar travels to the U.K. to help troubled dog owners with a territorial street dog and a Dalmatian whose personality can turn ugly.
British problem dogs including wild German Shepherds, a dog that must be muzzled by court order, and an English cocker spaniel that hates cars.
Problem dogs in the U.K. including two dogs that spent most of their lives in Africa, and a barking Jack Russell terrier mix.
Cesar's English adventure ends with an aggressive Klee Kai, a collie mix that hates walks, and a hyper Labrador.
Cesar brings discipline to four chaotic Chinese crested dogs, an over-energetic mastiff mix and two unruly miniature dachshunds.
Cesar helps the lead singer of Rooney with his aggressive pit bull, while writer and producer Paul needs help with his two Boston terriers.
Playboy Playmates, Miss February 2010 is having trouble with her Chihuahua, while Orange County, Miss September 2011 with her terrier pug mix.
Cesar helps comedians Skyler Stone, Ralphie May and Paul Rodriguez get to grips with their unruly hounds.
Cesar helps dogs overcome their fears including a whippet mix who is blind and deaf, a labradoodle that fears the ocean, and a cocker spaniel that fears all humans.
Cesar meets NASCAR driver Kevin Harvick to help with his snappy Chihuahua and an aggressive Pekingese called Gizmo.
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.
Achoo, achoo! What's that sound? Benny the Bull has the sneezes. It's Doctor Dora to the rescue as she sets off for Benny's barn for a house call.

Yee haw! Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots are riding through the Wild West on Pinto, the Pony Express. They have to deliver a special package of cowboy cookies to Benny the Bull. But they'll have to be on the lookout for Swiper.

Dora and Boots meet León, a friendly lion who wants to join the circus. They pedal on a unicycle, tightrope walk, and skate their way to the Big Top so León can become a circus lion and do all his tricks.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?

When Dora and Boots color in a picture of Mami Duck and her eggs, their coloring book magically comes to life, and the eggs start to hatch. Suddenly, the wind blows one of Mami Duck's eggs away. Oh no!
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Calling all trucks!  Boots sure loves trucks.  When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue.  Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
What are we going to do?  Cockledoodledoo!  Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun.  Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers, and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.
Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!
Dr. Mike breaks the rules to enter her new horse in an important race.
Dr. Mike must prove that Loren’s sister-in-law did not murder her abusive husband.
A dead man walks when Halloween comes to Colorado Springs.
Jake is accused of killing a Cheyenne brave, and the incident disrupts the town, as well as the friendship between Sully and Cloud Dancing.
Dr. Mike clashes with a traveling faith healer over a cure for Kid Cole’s tuberculosis.
When Michaela returns to Boston to visit her ailing mother, Sully must act before he loses her.
When Michaela returns to Boston to visit her ailing mother, Sully must act before he loses her.
A severe drought threatens -- and divides -- Colorado Springs at Thanksgiving.
Dr. Mike suspects that Dorothy is spending time with Sully, and Becky thinks Colleen stole her boyfriend.
The children hide a wounded Sully from the cavalry, which has put a bounty on his head.

programmes.st: A Christmas Tale - Dr. Mike's Dream
programmes.d: Dr. Mike sees Christmas past, present and future with the help of a beloved friend.
When Matthew is trapped in a mine cave and Sully is his only hope for rescue.
A typhus epidemic spreads at Black Kettle's camp, and Dr. Mike feels responsible.
The Circus comes to town.
Another woman comes between Sully and Dr. Mike.
When Dr. Mike helps the reverend find parents for orphaned children, he gets ideas about marrying her.
Sully and Dr. Mike take desperate action as the battle between the Buffalo Soldiers and The Dog Soldiers escalates.

Blake buys back his racehorse Allegre from owner Daniel Reece, who sends Krystle a gift. Furious, she demands to know how he dared approach her after what happened with her sister, Iris. Amanda learns she is Blake's daughter.

Krystle reconciles with Daniel, who reveals that his break-up with her sister was amicable. Claudia moves into La Mirage. Krystle confides to Steven that Daniel is Sammy Jo's father and therefore little Danny's grandfather.

Claudia rebuffs Steven's conciliatory attempts. Tension between Dex and Amanda continues to mount. On his deathbed, Tom Carrington makes amends with Blake, and in a final dramatic gesture, has his will changed.

Krystle begins working with Daniel. Blake is adamantly opposed and exchanges harsh words with Reece. Dex is furious with Alexis for traveling to Sumatra to see Blake's father. Alexis learns from Amanda about Dex's experience with Daniel in Vietnam.

Krystle launches her new business with the purchase of an Arabian horse. Sexual tension between Steven and Luke mounts. Jeff and Nikki return from Bolivia with the news of their marriage and they move into the mansion.

Blake returns triumphant from his negotiations with the Chinese. Alexis vows to buy into the venture. Krystle, uncomfortable with Daniel's increasing attention, avoids him. Blake invites Amanda to accompany him on a business trip to Acapulco.

Alexis attempts to persuade the head of the Chinese delegation to hire Colbyco. Blake is surprised to learn Lady Ashley is an Acapulco. Amanda has a romantic fling with Prince Michael of Moldavia. Krystle makes a surprise visit to Daniel.

Amanda spends the night with Prince Michael and then is heartsick to learn he is engaged. Dex persuades the Chinese delegation to use his company instead of Blake's for an important drilling job. Claudia finally accepts Adam's advances.

Tensions between Krystle and Blake mount as their suspicions of one another grow. Claudia regrets sleeping with Adam. Dominique derails Alexis' attempt to buy out her company but is unable to stop Brady's divorce proceedings.

Dominique remains in critical condition after collapsing. Luke pays an unexpected visit to Steven. Blake tells his son that he will support him regardless of his sexual persuasion. Alexis calls her former lover, King Galen, a Middle Eastern monarch.

Alexis attempts to persuade King Galen to allow a marriage between Amanda and his son. She sweetens the offer by suggesting his country would receive a portion of Colbyco's revenues. Dominique advises Krystle to reconcile with Blake.
Alexis is relieved and Blake is concerned when Amanda suddenly changes her mind and decides to marry Prince Michael. Sammy Jo is revealed to be the culprit behind the compromising photographs.

Claudia flies to Mexico to divorce Steven. Unexpectedly, Adam appears at her hotel and they spend the night together. After Amanda embarrasses Prince Michael at Dominique's party, his patience is exhausted and he leaves her.

Blake and Daniel survive the plane crash. Jeff charters a helicopter and braves hazardous conditions to finally locate the wreckage. Krystle and Blake finally clear the air and renew their commitment to each other.

Krystle accompanies Daniel to New York for his reunion with Sammy Jo, the child he's never known. While looking through photos Ashley snapped on assignment at a rock concert, Jeff is stunned to spot Fallon among the crowd.

As Alexis and Amanda emerge from an exclusive bridal salon, a car suddenly screeches to a halt and Amanda is pulled inside. A high-speed chase ensues. As Dex forces the kidnapper's car onto the sidewalk, Amanda breaks free.

Dex tells a devastated Krystle that Daniel Reece is dead. Steven is outraged when Sammy Jo decides to fight for custody of her son in court. Jeff proposes marriage to Ashley. Sammy Jo learns that her monies will be held in trust with Krystle as executor.
A woman fakes her own death to escape from her previous life.
A biophysicist goes missing after developing a deadly virus with no vaccine; Jess' mother and brother visit.
A pregnant woman is kidnapped and held for ransom.
The team searches for an abducted newborn.
Fish-out-of-water attorneys Amara and Titus Hughes adjust to new personal and professional challenges following their move to Atlanta, namely the ruthless Stephanie Carlisle Lancaster.

Amara puts Stephanie on notice; Atlanta's first lady learns a shocking secret from a rival's past; Bella makes a bold play to get what she wants; Rondell meets an intriguing ally in her fight to save her restaurant.
Stephanie continues her quest to repay Amara; Rondell falls out of favor with Senior, and Bella develops a new strategy.
Stephanie and Evan join forces for their own self-interest while Titus embarks on a mission that could jeopardize his entire career.
A newcomer to Atlanta carries out a nefarious plan; Stephanie deals from the bottom of the deck to get what she wants.
Stephanie is a force to be reckoned with at a Women's Empowerment Summit; Bella forges an alliance with Rod.
Stephanie makes an accusation and vows to get revenge; Bella navigates Rod and Evan; Amara forms an unlikely partnership that compels Titus to make questionable moves.
Stephanie and Irene conspire against Rondell; Titus takes matters into his own hands.
When Grace confesses to her family, not all the Greenleafs are on her side; the situation is complicated by police, lies, affairs, and the interests of Harmony and Hope.
The Bishop plans a romantic surprise for Lady Mae; Lady Mae learns that her name is being erased from the scholarship fund at Calvary and sets out to protect her legacy.

Lady Mae and Bishop throw an impromptu party to subvert Harmony and Hope's plans for Calvary; Charity's loyalties are questioned; Grace navigates between playing the obedient pastor for Judee Whitmore and her parents' schemes.

Bishop moves to prevent Judee Whitmore's proposed governance structure; Jacob and Kerissa attempt to mend their wounds; a secret about Phil threatens his relationship with Charity; Grace realizes that what is right has never been less clear.

Bob Whitmore returns to Calvary; Phil asks Charity for a very important yes; Fernando Amable gives Kerissa information about the Greenleaf's hazy past; Lady Mae considers an offer that would achieve her dream.

programmes.d: Monica tries to help divergent members of a group of terminally ill people who know they are going to die fulfill their final wishes.

A devastated Andrew believes that he has failed in his attempt to help a family through a life-changing ordeal.
Monica, Tess and Andrew help a young man lost in a life or death struggle with what seems to be a case of split personality, but turns out to be something far more sinister.
An envious Monica quits her angelic duties after meeting a musical prodigy who does not appreciate having a gift that Monica desperately covets.

programmes.st: The Whole Truth and Nothing But
programmes.d: A driven newspaper editor must choose between a shocking front page headline or her own sister's reputation.
After a man, who has been living in his father's shadow, inherits the family taffy factory to which he has never felt attached, he must choose whether or not to sell it.
When a woman's husband is murdered and she is left penniless, she must face returning to the bad neighborhood she worked so hard to flee.
On New Year's Eve, a melancholy woman races against time to fulfill a promise she made to her father 45 years earlier.

Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!
A SFPD undercover narcotics cop aims to avenge his partner's death and destroy a drug-smuggling ring operated by the Chinese Triads.
A maverick Texas Ranger throws down his guns to indulge his talents in the martial arts when he meets his match in the leader of a gun-smuggling ring.
American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

When a stakeout marred by mob interference results in the death of an innocent bystander and a police cover-up, a Chicago detective is forced to adhere to his own personal code of ethics in an effort to rid the Windy City of its Warring crime factions.

An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage, and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.
Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true – the scent of ambergris sends them wild. But it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and has all three mermaid girls on his arm!
Rikki tries to avoid Zane when he comes back, but needs his help after an incident with a speedboat. Meanwhile, Charlotte continues to flirt with Lewis and Cleo worries for their secret.

Cleo and Rikki push Ash into asking Emma out again – little did they know he’d turn up at Emma’s place in time for a full moon! Rikki and Cleo are both moonstruck and Ash looks set to discover Emma’s secret.
For the first anniversary of the girls being mermaids, Cleo decides to throw a party. However, Emma and Rikki fall out following a fight between Ash and Zane and Cleo may have to celebrate alone.

Lewis discovers someone called Max Hamilton did research fifty years ago on the strange properties of Mako Island. Lewis tracks the old man down and finds that he knows a lot more about mermaids than Lewis first thought.

Charlotte demands answers to why Lewis is hanging out with the girls so much. She believe an excuse from Cleo, but then a discovery from inside Max's research brings her to the secret! Meanwhile, Ash decides to help Emma with her fear of water.

Charlotte follows Lewis to Max Hamilton. Max tells all to Charlotte when he discovers she’s the granddaughter of his one true love. Charlotte and Lewis almost break up until she goes to the moonpool, becoming a mermaid herself!

The girls have to deal with a fourth mermaid who turns out to be a loose cannon; Charlotte almost turns into a mermaid at a volleyball competition. Charlotte discovers she has all three mermaid superpowers.

As the girls continue to have problems accommodating Charlotte as a mermaid, Nate bullies Lewis. Despite the girls’ attempts to keep Charlotte under control, she uses her powers on Nate and almost exposes them all.

Charlotte takes over and organises a surprise party for Lewis, annoying Rikki. At the party, Charlotte is jealous of Cleo and traps her and Emma in a pool room. Rikki comes back just in time. From now on, Charlotte is on her own.

Cleo is bullied by Charlotte and runs away to the ocean. With Cleo missing, everyone becomes more and more worried. Lewis discovers what Charlotte has been up to and breaks up with her. He finds Cleo and they kiss.

The full moon rises, and with the planets lining up, it can remove mermaid powers for good. Knowing this, Lewis lures Charlotte to the moon pool but it backfires and Emma, Cleo and Rikki all look set to lose their powers.

Melinda must go into the complex world of high school dating and gossip to find the reason behind hauntings at Ned's school.

Melinda has trouble dealing with a ghost who blames Jim for his untimely death. However, when she begins her investigation into the ghost's death, Melinda discovers he is attached to the new doctor in town who he blames for his death.

Samantha and Jay throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a rundown country estate they inherited into a bed and breakfast - only to find it's inhabited by the many spirits of deceased residents who now call it home.

Samantha and Jay throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a rundown country estate they inherited into a bed & breakfast - only to find it's inhabited by the many opinionated spirits of deceased residents who now call it home.
When Thorfinn's bones are discovered on the Woodstone property, he asks Sam to conduct the traditional Viking funeral he's always wanted.
When Sam and Jay invite their nosy neighbors to a dinner party to woo them into allowing the bed and breakfast, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included on the guest list.
On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who vandalize it every year.
Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret from him for many years.

When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she's embarrassed about a part of the story she's never revealed.
After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts.
Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go for a walk with him, hoping it will spark a special memory.
Hetty accidentally possesses Jay's body just as he and Sam are about to show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner.
Sam and Jay travel to where Sam's mother, Sheryl (Rachael Harris), died to see if she's now a ghost. Also, Sasappis divulges a secret he overheard Sam and Jay discussing to his fellow ghosts.
When Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), comes to visit Sam and Jay after being dumped by her boyfriend, they're shocked to discover that she's communicating with someone they know on a dating app.
Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend's wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty's husband, Elias Woodstone (Matt Walsh), tries to ruin it.

When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a friend, and Flower tries to be Pete's basketball buddy.
When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him.

The secret about Trevor's missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone's corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

An '80s "mean girl" ghost named Stephanie (Odessa A'Zion), who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official bed-and-breakfast guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn, and Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.
Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to bring Nigel into his friend group in the second-season premiere.
Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta's death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay's new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah (Drew Tarver). Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try saving an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower's attention.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

Ricky scoffs at his wife and Ethel when they adamantly participate in the hunt for the "Bonus Buck" that will win them prize money from a newspaper contest. Later,  Ricky discovers one of the lucky bucks in his own wallet.

Lucy decides that Ricky needs an agent to negotiate more money and cut down on his fruitless personal appearances, so she appoints herself. Her fast talking, no-nonsense actions result in the studio canceling Ricky's contract.
Ricky and his band are going on a tour and Lucy wants to go too. She dusts off her old saxophone and goes down to the club dressed in a zoot suit to audition for a spot.

Lucy is desperate to appear in a Hollywood movie after hearing the Mertzes have bit parts in an upcoming feature. She sets out to be "discovered" and lands a part in an MGM musical. She plays a showgirl in a glamorous nightclub scene but has some trouble.

Ricky tries to get a raise from his boss Mr. Littlefield but he is denied. Littlefield hires another act for the Tropicana and Lucy, Ethel and Fred decide to make sure no one shows up for the opening.

Lucy and Ethel are eager to get a closer look at the belongings of the O'Briens, new neighbors in the building. They snoop around in their apartment while they are away and when they hear the O'Briens return, Lucy is trapped in the closet.

In a deception planned to convince Ricky that she ought to be in his new nightclub act, Lucy pretends to have a nervous breakdown. She consults a book on abnormal psychology that reveals three complexes she assumes.

Ricky is the emcee for a television variety show and Lucy wants to appear in one of its commercials. To prove to her husband that she has screen presence, she removes the inner parts of their TV set, gets into it, and does a commercial as he arrives home.

Lucy has agreed to write an article entitled "What It's Like To Be Married To Ricky Ricardo" for a magazine when she learns from Ricky's press agent that Ricky is going to host a TV show. Lucy desperately wants to appear on the show with Ricky.
The Ricardos and the Mertzes are arrested when they're caught speeding in Bent Fork, Tennessee. Although Ricky just wants to pay the fine, Lucy protests that they are being treated unfairly.

For their trip out west, Ricky buys a new car to replace the old, beat-up one Fred bought. Lucy convinces her husband to teach her how to drive it. After one driving lesson, Ricky is a harried and beaten man.
Lucy, while souvenir collecting, lifted a cement block with John Wayne's footprints from Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and now a newspaper is reporting that she was seen and her arrest is imminent.

A close inspection of her marriage license convinces Lucy that she and Ricky are not legally married. Because his name is misspelled on the certificate, Lucy insists Ricky go through the entire courtship and ultimately the marriage ceremony again.

Lucy decides that the Ricardos need a bigger apartment. She discovers that an older couple in the building just had their daughter move out and they no longer need the extra space. All she needs to do is to convince Ricky to go along with the trade.

programmes.st: Little Ricky Learns To Play The Drums
programmes.d: Although they both agree not to try and influence Little Ricky's future, Lucy buys a toy doctor kit and Ricky gives him a drum set. Their son takes to the drums and begins to play it non-stop for days.

Lucy wants to get into the act when Ricky is producing an Indian show at the Tropicana. Ricky instead hires the Mertzes to be part of the show, hoping Lucy will be cured of her show biz bug now that she is a mother.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes are cast in Little Ricky's school play when it runs short of cast members. Ricky plays a hollow tree, Lucy is the wicked witch, Fred plays the friendly frog, and Ethel is transformed in to the fairy princess.

Lucy and Ricky are exhausted from walking the baby at night and hire a maid. Lucy prepares a list of dos and don'ts in order to set down the law for her new employee. However when Mrs. Porter arrives, she has her own list for her employer.

How long can Ricky Ricardo go, without losing his temper? When Lucy buys a new hat for $49.50, Ricky goes ballistic. To make a point, Lucy bets Ricky the cost of the hat that he'll lose his temper long before her next purchase.

Ricky's friend Charlie Appleby and his wife Caroline are coming over for dinner at the Ricardos. Charlie is going to have Ricky emcee a TV program he's working on and so Ricky wants to make a good impression at dinner.

programmes.st: Lucy Wants To Move To The Country
programmes.d: Lucy has become tired of living in the city and drops some none-too-subtle hints to Ricky that it would be nice to move to the country. Unbeknownst to her Ricky has already placed a comfortable deposit on a house in Westport, Connecticutt.

An eligible bachelor is in town, and Lucy wants to set him up with a girlfriend of hers. The bachelor is a lingerie salesman by the name of Eddie Grant who is a friend of the Mertzes. Unfortunately, Lucy's attempts at matchmaking fail.

Lucy buys a costly dress, and when Ricky tells her to take it back or pay for it herself, she decides to get a job. She answers an ad for a babysitter and finds herself in charge of high-spirited twin boys who are to appear in an amateur contest.

One of the girls in Ricky's show quits, creating a vacancy which Lucy wants to fill. She goes down for an audition and can have the part provided she loses twelve ponds in four days to fit into the previous singer's size 12 outfit.

Lucy anticipates a 2nd honeymoon with Ricky on their boat trip to Europe, but Ricky's band duties keep him too busy. Lucy happily looks forward to romantic evenings and daytime deck games on board the ship as the Ricardos and the Mertzes sail for Europe.
Lucy sees Ricky's screen test as an opportunity to get discovered as a new movie star.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are out a restaurant and Lucy keeps changing her order and their seating. Ricky points out that she constantly changes her mind and never completes things.

Ricky agrees reluctantly to host a new television show, sponsored by Phipps Department Store, and learns they'd like him to host with his wife Lucy. When Lucy finds out that Ricky didn't want her in the show, she sets out to sabotage the program.

Ricky Ricardo hires business manager Mr. Hickox to solve the family budget problems. Lucy, dissatisfied with her new $5 per month allowance, manages to find a loophole in the business manager's system.

Lucy learns her husband's film Don Juan will be shelved and works frantically with the Mertzes and Mrs. McGillicuddy to prevent it from happening. Together they write hundreds of fan letters and dress up as members of the Ricky Ricardo Fan Club.

Lucy decides to try a new look, despite her husband Ricky's objections. She borrows a black wig from her hairdresser Roberta, who tells Lucy it makes her look like a whole different person. With that in mind, Lucy decides to play a little trick on Ricky.

programmes.st: Lucy Thinks Ricky has Been Drafted
programmes.d: Lucy opens a telegram addressed to Ricky from the War Department ordering him to appear at the Army's Fort Dix. This letter plus the drills Ricky and Fred have been practicing in the living room convince the women that their husbands have been drafted.
The four remaining artists meet their canvases for the last elimination tattoo, the judges choose the final three contestants, and the epic final challenge is revealed.
The contestants return to reflect on their eliminations, the finalists and their master canvases participate in a 24-hour tattoo challenge, an Ink Master is chosen.
The artists create single-needle tattoos for inmates in their first Flash Challenge, and canvases seek cover-ups in the elimination challenge.
The artists team up to create customized grills for lowrider cars, canvases sit for gory tattoos, and NFL star Chris Johnson joins the panel as a guest judge.
The artists test their texture skills in a sexy Flash Challenge, a difficult canvas leads to a second elimination, and tattoo veteran Tony Hundahl joins as a guest judge.
The artists must assemble their own tattoo machines before tattooing bar codes onto their canvases, and tattoo machine innovator Seth Ciferri joins as a guest judge.
The artists tackle tattooing over scarred skin in the Flash Challenge, a canvas asks for a Day of the Dead portrait of Tatu Baby, and artist Chuey Quintanar is a guest judge.
The artists transform models into animals in the Flash Challenge, and veteran tattoo artist Troy Denning judges the artists' Asian-style tattoos in the elimination challenge.
Dave acts as a human canvas in the Flash Challenge, the artists struggle through landmark-themed tattoos, and color realism expert Nikko Hurtado is a guest judge.
The artists must tattoo one another in the Flash Challenge, surprise canvases sit for a pinup Elimination Tattoo, and NFL star NaVorro Bowman is a guest judge.
The artists etch designs into human skulls, canvases sit for super-villain-themed tattoos, and DC Comics artist Greg Capullo is a guest judge.
The artists get squeamish when tattooing eyelids, a canvas requests a portrait of one of the judges during the Elimination Tattoo, and artist Corey Miller is a guest judge.
The artists honor military veterans by engraving dog tags on the deck of an aircraft carrier, canvases get complex tattoos on their heads, and Twig Sparks is a guest judge.
Past guest judges give the artists designs, one canvas sits for a simultaneous tattoo, and the artists are given the freedom to create Elimination Tattoos.
America's vote brings two eliminated artists back for a live tattoo face-off, and after a final 35-hour tattoo, the judges award one artist with the title of Ink Master.
A new batch of artists face off in a convention-style challenge to earn their spot in the competition, and the judges assign canvases to the artists in the elimination tattoo.
The Band of Seven, a group of ghosts, have been brought back to life.
The match between Jakotsu and Inuyasha is stopped when Mukotsu interferes. Mukotsu kidnaps Kagome to make her his bride.
Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have been weakened by Mukotsu's poison.

programmes.st: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango: Desperate Situation!
programmes.d: At the temple, Inuyasha checks to see of Kagome and the others are safe. He ends up trusting Renkotsu. Ginkotsu bombards him.

programmes.st: Inuyasha Shows His Tears For The First Time
programmes.d: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have stopped breathing. Inuyasha searches for the Band of Seven to avenge them.

programmes.st: The Secret of the Pure Light
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang approach the light of a Sacred Jewel which appears to belong to the Band of Seven, but the light is not corrupt.

programmes.st: Hidden in the Mist: Onward to Mt. Hakurei!
programmes.d: Suikotsu's Band of Seven personality awakens and fights Inuyasha. When the children call out to him to turn back, he holds his head in pain.

programmes.st: Enter Bankotsu, The Leader of the Band of Seven
programmes.d: There is a barrier around Mt. Hakurei that purifies demons or anything evil.

programmes.st: The Big Clash: Banryu versus the Wind Scar
programmes.d: The battle between Bankotsu and Inuyasha begins. Meanwhile, Sesshomatu comes to Mt. Hakurei.

programmes.st: Afloat on the Lake Surface: the Barrier of Hijiri Island
programmes.d: There is a holy island in a lake surrounded by mist. Saint Hakushin, who become a living Buddha a hundred years ago, is venerated there.

programmes.st: The Sacred Vajra and the Mystery of the Living Buddha
programmes.d: Bankotsu gets Kagome and the others involved in his battle with Inuyasha. Inuyasha is angered that his friends are getting hurt, and corners Bankotsu.
Mt. Hakurei's holy barrier prevents demons from entering it. Saint Hakushin helped Naraku, and placed the barrier.
Mt. Hakurei gets stronger, and Kikyo is prevented from going into its hold ground.
Suikotsu cannot kill Chiyo and the others. Jakotsu stops him. He senses an attack from Sesshomaru.

programmes.st: Vanished in a River of Flames
programmes.d: Ginkotsu has died, and Renkotsu uses his shard without permission. In doing so, he has betrayed Bankotsu. He cannot go back anymore.

programmes.st: Into the Depths of Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: The evil within Mt. Hakurei is Naraku's demons and Kagura. Miroku risks his life to save Sango, by opening his Wind Tunnel and sucking in the demons.
Miroku and Sango come face to face with the Saint Hakushin's mummy on Mt. Hakurei. The saint tells them his reason for helping Naraku.
Inuyasha regains his demon powers. He defeats Jakotsu, and hurries to Mt. Hakurei. Renkotsu has rebellious feelings towards Bankotsu.

programmes.st: Final Battle: The Last and Strongest of the Band of Seven
programmes.d: Mt. Hakurei's barrier disappears. Inuyasha is worried about Kagome. Kagome heads to Mt. Hakurei with Koga and the others.

programmes.st: The Power of Banryu: Duel to the Death on Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: Miroku and Sango see a mysterious lump of flesh in the depths of Mt. Hakurei.
Naraku has gained a new body and has been reborn.
Mt. Hakurei is destroyed. Koga falls to the bottom of it. Inuyasha saves him.
Inuyasha is pulled away from his friends when he is tricked by fake information that Kikyo is still alive.
Naraku's baby carries Kagome to an abandoned temple. He orders Kagura to place a corrupt Sacred Jewel shard in her.

programmes.st: Don't Boil It! The Terrifying Dried-Up Demon!
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, Naraku has sent a demon called Mimisenri to look for the Sacred Jewel shards.

programmes.st: Battle Against the Dried-Up Demons at the Cultural Festival!
programmes.d: On the day of the cultural festival, the dried demons that Kagome brought from feudal Japan are revived. They devour the food that Yuka and the others made.
A demon named Chokyukai is revived, and begins to steal girls. A young man named Kisuke comes to Kaede for help. Inuyasha go to defeat the demon.

programmes.st: Shippo's New Technique, The Heart Scar!
programmes.d: Five demon fox brothers believe Shippo to be a hero. They become his disciples to learn his special technique, the Wind Scar.

programmes.st: Trap of The Cursed Wall Hanging
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Shinosuke, who is looking for his fiancée. They are led to a village of only women, and are separated by sex into their rooms.

programmes.t: Inuyasha Movie 4: Fire on the Mystic Island (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Inuyasha faces the Four War Gods and the past he left behind on Horai Island fifty years ago.
Jane and Michael are back together, almost! Jane attempts to get Rafael and Michael to reconcile, but it doesn't go well. Rafael sulks over losing Jane and ignores Petra's pregnancy needs.
Jane and Michael are back together and Jane wishes she had never left Michael in the first place. Rafael appears to have regressed to his playboy ways and Petra is concerned about him.
Rafael and Petra are new parents but Petra is already back to work and appears to be not interested in motherhood. Xo has invited Alba's old flame Pablo to visit.
Jane and Michael's wedding plans are side tracked when the Villanueva house is ruined by a flood. Jane wants a small wedding, but Rogelio wants to throw Jane a big blow out wedding.
Jane has a specific idea of how she wants to celebrate her bachelorette party, but when Xo and Lina get involved, nothing goes as planned.
After Jane and Xo's fallout from Jane's bachelorette party, Jane now needs to someone to watch Mateo. When Michael volunteers to help everything is perfect until Mateo does something.
Jane takes on additional shifts at the Marbella to make extra money, but it cuts into her time with Mateo. Jane and Rafael agree to a formal custody agreement and decide to use a mediator.
The Villanueva women have a tradition for Mother's Day and Jane is excited to participate as a new mom. However, their plans are thwarted when Petra invites everyone to a brunch instead.
Jane has made big plans to celebrate Mateo's first birthday, but things start to fall apart when she learns there might be an issue with her wedding venue.
After moving up the wedding day, Jane and Michael find all their carefully made plans thrown into chaos. To make matters worse, Jane is unhappy with her current graduate thesis.

Jane discovers that Michael was shot and finds herself having to make difficult choices. With Rafael focused on keeping Mateo safe, Anezka, who is pretending to be Petra, "helps" the cops with their investigation.

When Rafael finally admits that he is over Jane, their co-parenting style is tested when they argue over what the best preschool is for Mateo. Xo is paranoid about Alba finding out her secret and what it will do to their relationship.
Jane continues to work on her thesis and she decides to add Alba's estranged sister to the narrative, much to Alba's dismay. Rogelio tries for his chance at being an American crossover star.

Jane and Michael's housewarming party hits a snag when they discover they are being evicted for not paying their rent. Rogelio is still trying to break into American television, but needs some unusual help from Rafael.

Jane convinces Alba to let her read the letters from her estranged sister, but under the condition Jane doesn't reach out to her family. Rafael is starting to suspect that something is different with Petra.

When Jane's cousin unexpectedly shows up at her door, Jane questions her own less than spontaneous life. Xo finds the perfect location for her dance studio, but it happens to be near her ex-boyfriend, Bruce.

When Alba makes Jane feel guilty for not attending church, Jane decides she wants to bring Mateo against Rafael's wishes. Rafael unlocks a long lost memory of his mother, which could be a clue in the Mutter case. Rogelio hires a matchmaker.

Olivia is suing her best friend's daughter over a utility bill but Kalia wants nothing to do with her.
